## Responsible AI you can trust

Trusaic AI is being developed with enterprise-grade security and compliance at its core. Users who choose to leverage it will be empowered to move fast without compromising legal defensibility or data integrity.

- **Transparent**: Every AI recommendation will be backed by traceable logic, documented assumptions, and explainable methodology.
- **Compliant**: It will be aligned with the EU AI Act, Pay Transparency Directive, CCPA, GDPR, and global labor regulations.
- **Enterprise Secure**: It will be SOC 2 certified, ISO 42001, and ISO 27001 compliant, with encryption, access controls, and audit trails.
- **Privacy-First**: It is being designed with data minimization and global privacy protections built in from the ground up.

[Learn More](https://trusaic.com/responsible-ai/)

![Responsible AI you can trust](https://trusaic.com/wp-content/uploads/Responsible-AI-you-can-trust.webp)

## FAQs

1. ##### What is Trusaic AI™?





Trusaic AI is Trusaic’s proprietary artificial intelligence currently in development that is trained on the world’s most trusted pay equity and pay transparency methodology. Once live, users will have the option to embed the agents into pay equity and pay transparency workflows in the platform to achieve global compliance with greater speed, accuracy, and confidence.

2. ##### Is my data going to be shared with public LLM models?





No. Your data will never be shared with public LLM models.

3. ##### How will Trusaic AI enhance decision-making?





Trusaic AI will deliver intelligent, context-aware support at key decision points. Whether you’re remediating pay disparities or preparing compliance reports, Trusaic AI will provide precise, explainable recommendations that reduce uncertainty and accelerate confident action.

4. ##### What tasks can Trusaic AI agents help with?





Our AI agents will be purpose-built to simplify the most complex aspects of pay equity:

5. ##### Will Trusaic AI be secure and compliant with global regulations?





Yes. Trusaic AI is being designed for enterprise-grade security and global compliance. It’s will be SOC 2 certified, ISO 42001 compliant, ISO 27001 compliant, and aligned with GDPR, CCPA, the EU Pay Transparency Directive, and the EU AI Act when launched. Every recommendation will be fully transparent, auditable, and legally defensible.

6. ##### How will Trusaic AI be different from general-purpose AI tools?





Unlike general AI models, Trusaic AI is being purpose-built for compensation and compliance, and trained exclusively on Trusaic’s validated methodology. It will deliver answers you can act on — grounded in best practices, compliant logic, and expert-level understanding of global pay equity standards.
